name: Calm Before the Storm
summary: After the queen falls, you carry the latest findings from Un'Goro beyond Gadgetzan. Alchemist Pestlezugg sends the report to Gracina Spiritmight at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

sections.title: A Report for Darnassus
sections.body: Alchemist Pestlezugg says Gadgetzan cannot face the silithid alone. The latest findings from Un'Goro must reach someone who can act on them, so you carry the report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus. Pestlezugg hopes she is at the Temple of the Moon. She has friends among the Alliance's leading figures, and drawing them in may offer a way through this alive.

sections.title: Gracina's Answer
sections.body: Gracina Spiritmight welcomes the report, yet doubts it will help. She says those who cannot look past their hatred of the Horde are fools. The Alliance ignores every threat but the Horde, and even Darnassus's leaders disagree about the silithid. Gracina says Fandral Staghelm believes they are unlike the ancient peril she sees in them. She cannot prove the danger further without dropping someone into a hive. She urges you to stay committed to defeating the silithid.

faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg sends you from Gadgetzan with the report of the latest findings from Un'Goro.

faq.answer: Deliver the report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus, at the Temple of the Moon, where Pestlezugg last knew her to be.

faq.q: Why does Pestlezugg send the report to Gracina Spiritmight?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan cannot face the silithid alone. Gracina has friends among the Alliance's leading figures, and drawing them in may offer a way through this alive.
